name: the lockup settles with a soon and a link
looks: The mark and a short wordmark settle together on a near-black ground. A line restating that the symbol was never just one thing fades in beneath, then a short word promising it is coming soon, and finally a small site address, each arriving a beat after the last and holding still.
build: Mark+wordmark arrive together as one group (y 8-12px -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1, power2.out); the restating tagline fades in 150-200ms later; the 'soon' word and the site address follow with their own short delay, no further motion once settled.
sound: A soft low swell that fades out under the hold, no new hits once the last line lands.
prompt: Close on the mark and name settling together on a plain dark ground, a one-line statement restating the film's turn fading in beneath, then a short 'coming soon' word and a small site address arriving last and holding -- a quiet, static resting beat to end on.
